title: Official Illustration Extraction + Exact Topic Mapping
mapping_rule: Each asset is linked to the audited physical PDF page and to the verified topic(s) covered on that page. Multiple topic IDs are retained when a page contains multiple verified subtopics; no unsupported single-topic inference is used.
ui_integration: Study detail displays the first mapped official visual for the topic.
Visual Library displays all extracted official visuals with source/page/topic metadata.
Service worker precaches the visual manifest and extracted official assets.
remaining_final_phase_items: Full source-content population remains in progress beyond the current verified seed records.
Device-level mobile Safari/Chrome install/offline/live GitHub Pages QA still required.
